cds.title: Indiana State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, 06.16.26 update)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 first-time first-year class (CDS C1 residency breakdown: 440 international applicants, 390 admitted, 26 enrolled; 2 applicants of unknown residency). Undergrad enrollment 6,352 and intl 104 are the B2 total undergraduates / nonresident figures. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11 (the 1.0-1.99 and below-1.0 rows are blank). CDS C7 factor checkboxes are not legible in the PDF text, so factors are omitted. Student-to-faculty ratio is blank in the CDS.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A answered 'No' (SAT/ACT not used in admission); admissions site says scores are not required for admission.

cost.notes: CDS G1/G5 (2025-26, first-year): the CDS lists one nonresident tuition figure ($22,646) equal to out-of-state tuition, used as the international rate. The university tuition page lists 2026-27 out-of-state/international tuition of $11,641 per semester (about $23,282 per year; in-state $4,989 per semester unchanged).
